**Error response shape**: identical union `ErrorResponse`.

**Error codes**:
| Code | HTTP | Condition |
|---|---:|---|
| `GRAPHQL_PARSE_FAILED` / `GRAPHQL_VALIDATION_FAILED` / `BAD_USER_INPUT` | 400 | Standard gateway. |
| `UNAUTHENTICATED_ERROR` / `FORBIDDEN_ERROR` | 401 / 403 | Auth; tenant mismatch. |
| `ERR-INV-048` | 400 | `input.rows.length > 500` or `input.rows` empty — **BFF defensive throws BEFORE forward** (per §3g.3 + ADR-018/022 3-layer defense); backend also throws same code (BR-OB-004b). |
| `ERR-CMN-validation` | 400 | `fileChecksum` malformed (non-SHA-256), `rows[].asOfDate` malformed (not `YYYY-MM-DD`). |
| `ERR-INV-009` / `ERR-INV-010` / `ERR-INV-017` / `ERR-INV-018` / `ERR-INV-019` / `ERR-INV-020` / `ERR-INV-024` / `ERR-INV-032` / `ERR-INV-033` / `ERR-INV-034` / `ERR-INV-035` / `ERR-INV-036` | 400 (per-row) | Row-level validation errors surface inside `previewLines[].errors[]` — response body is `200 OK`; these codes appear only if BE returns them at top-level (fatal file-level, rare). Per-code semantics = `gf-inventory-api.md §3b.3`. |
| `TIMEOUT_ERROR` / `HTTP_ERROR` / `API_ERROR` | downstream | Forward. gf-accounting lock-check 502/503 → surface as `warningLockCheckUnavailable: true` in data payload, NOT as GraphQL error (ADR-021 fail-OPEN verify marker). |
| `UNKNOWN_ERROR` / `INTERNAL_ERROR` | 500 | Fallback. |

#### Mutation `importOpeningBalances`

Module: `opening-balance`. Return type: `ImportOpeningBalancesResultApiResponse!`.

**Transport**: `POST /graphql`.
**Auth**: authenticated/context-dependent.
**Idempotency**: **Idempotent via required `idempotencyKey` argument** (format `OB-IMPORT-{tenantId}-{uuid}` per ADR-022). Argument forwarded as HTTP header `X-Idempotency-Key: {value}` to downstream; downstream dedup 24h via `processed_events` per `gf-inventory-HLD.md §5`. BFF defense-in-depth: rejects `input.rows.length > 500` với `ERR-INV-048`.
**Downstream**:

| REST target | Method | Path | Ref |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gf-inventory` | `POST` | `/api/v2/opening-balances/import` (with header `X-Idempotency-Key`) | W04-4 (`gf-inventory-api.md §3b.2`) |

**Request** (client re-submits same shape as `verifyImportOpeningBalances` after preview `canCommit=true`; server-side re-validates authoritative + re-runs lock-check per ADR-021 authoritative commit-time; single `@Transactional` all-or-nothing commit; cascade sổ tồn atomic via `StockLedgerRecomputeService` per ADR-020):
```json
{
  "headers": {
    "Authorization": "Bearer <access-token>",
    "x-request-id": "req-20260707-0004"
  },
  "operationName": "importOpeningBalances",
  "query": "mutation importOpeningBalances($input: VerifyImportOpeningBalancesInput!, $idempotencyKey: String!) { importOpeningBalances(input: $input, idempotencyKey: $idempotencyKey) { __typename ... on ImportOpeningBalancesResultApiResponse { __typename success code message data { __typename totalRows importedRows importedAt importedBy fileName fileChecksum alreadyImported cascadedKeys { __typename productCode warehouseCode fromDate recomputedRows } } } ... on ErrorResponse { __typename id code serverResponse message statusCode path timestamp details } } }",
  "variables": {
    "input": {
      "fileName": "OB-2026-Q1.xlsx",
      "fileChecksum": "sha256:abc123def456",
      "rows": [
        {
          "rowNumber": 2,
          "productCode": "SP-NB-000123",
          "productName": "Lốp xe 175/70R13",
          "unitName": "Cái",
          "mainUnitCode": "UNIT_CAI",
          "warehouseName": "Kho tổng",
          "warehouseId": 12,
          "quantity": 240,
          "value": 12000000,
          "asOfDate": "2026-01-01"
        }
      ]
    },
    "idempotencyKey": "OB-IMPORT-1001-b3d2e7a1-4f8c-4a2f-8e6b-2c9a1d5e7f0a"
  }
}
```

**Response 200** (backend passthrough W04-4; `importedRows == totalRows` per BR-OB-004a all-or-nothing; `cascadedKeys[]` reports each distinct `(productCode, warehouseCode)` touched với number of ledger rows recomputed forward per ADR-020; `alreadyImported=true` when idempotency-key replay hits dedup cache):
```json
{
  "data": {
    "importOpeningBalances": {
      "__typename": "ImportOpeningBalancesResultApiResponse",
      "success": true,
      "code": "OK",
      "message": "Success",
      "data": {
        "__typename": "ImportOpeningBalancesResult",
        "totalRows": 1,
        "importedRows": 1,
        "importedAt": "2026-07-07T09:45:12Z",
        "importedBy": "operator@garage.com",
        "fileName": "OB-2026-Q1.xlsx",
        "fileChecksum": "sha256:abc123def456",
        "alreadyImported": false,
        "cascadedKeys": [
          {
            "__typename": "StockLedgerCascadeAudit",
            "productCode": "SP-NB-000123",
            "warehouseCode": "WH-01",
            "fromDate": "2026-01-01",
            "recomputedRows": 8
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  }
}
```

**Error response shape**: identical union `ErrorResponse`.

**Error codes**:
| Code | HTTP | Condition |
|---|---:|---|
| `GRAPHQL_PARSE_FAILED` / `GRAPHQL_VALIDATION_FAILED` / `BAD_USER_INPUT` | 400 | Standard gateway; missing required `idempotencyKey` arg → `BAD_USER_INPUT`. |
| `UNAUTHENTICATED_ERROR` / `FORBIDDEN_ERROR` | 401 / 403 | Auth; tenant mismatch. |
| `ERR-INV-048` | 400 | `input.rows.length > 500` — BFF defensive throws (per §3g.3). |
| `ERR-CMN-validation` | 400 | `idempotencyKey` malformed (not matching `OB-IMPORT-{tenantId}-{uuid}` pattern). |
| `ERR-INV-034` | 400 | Trùng OB (mã+kho) — either dedup-in-file or vs existing DB row (BR-OB-012); all-or-nothing rollback (per `gf-inventory-api.md §3b.3`). |
| `ERR-INV-024` | 400 | Any row's `asOfDate` falls in CLOSED accounting period (authoritative re-check at commit per ADR-021); all-or-nothing rollback. |
| `ERR-INV-035` | 400 | OB `asOfDate` ≥ existing slip date for (mã+kho) — OB must precede slips (BR-OB-016). |
| `ERR-INV-036` | 400 | Cascade recompute làm `closing_qty < 0` tại some day — invariant violation per BR-STKV2-005a step 4 (ADR-020); transaction rollback. |
| `ERR-INV-009` / `ERR-INV-010` / `ERR-INV-017` / `ERR-INV-018` / `ERR-INV-019` / `ERR-INV-020` / `ERR-INV-032` / `ERR-INV-033` | 400 | Row-level validation (product not found, inactive, missing field, malformed date, unit mismatch, warehouse not found, qty ≤ 0, value < 0). Response shape includes `errorRows[]` list (same shape as verify preview). |
| `409` (conflict) | 409 | `X-Idempotency-Key` dedup 24h hit — returns previous response with `alreadyImported: true` inside 200 body, NOT 409 (per W04-4 semantics `gf-inventory-api.md §3b.2`). |
| `503` | 503 | gf-accounting lock-check unreachable → **fail-CLOSED per ADR-021** commit path → surfaces as `HTTP_ERROR 503 ERR-CMN-007` ("Hệ thống đang bận, vui lòng thử lại sau" — platform-wide toast, đã đăng ký `Product/error-code/ERROR-CODE-REGISTRY.md:71`). |
| `TIMEOUT_ERROR` / `HTTP_ERROR` / `API_ERROR` | downstream | Forward. |
| `UNKNOWN_ERROR` / `INTERNAL_ERROR` | 500 | Fallback (e.g. Redisson lock timeout in recompute). |
